run_custom_cnn_example: run the custom CNN example script to predict parameters and evaluate on CIFAR-10
create_cnn_model: create a PyTorch CNN model with Conv2d, AvgPool2d, and Linear layers for image classification
predict_parameters_with_ghn2: predict all parameters for a custom neural network model using GHN2 on a dataset
load_image_dataset: load a CIFAR-10 or ImageNet validation dataset using the ppuda image_loader function
evaluate_model_accuracy: evaluate a model's top-1 and top-5 accuracy on a validation image dataset using infer
